Louisiana Tech ranks 63rd on offense, converting on 40.5% of third downs. Louisiana Tech is 4th in the FBS with a +14 turnover margin. Louisiana Tech ranks 108th in the FBS averaging 64.4 penalty yards per game, compared to Arkansas State's 24th-ranked 44.5 per-game average. Arkansas State is 92nd in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 82.1% of trips. Louisiana Tech's red zone defense ranks 34th at 79.3%. Team leaders Louisiana Tech Passing: Blake Baker, 1,740 yards, 17 TDs, 1 INT, 73.0 completion percentage Rushing: Andrew Burnette, 394 yards on 100 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Jalen Mickens, 695 yards on 55 catches, 4 TDs Arkansas State Passing: Trey Owens, 2,350 yards, 12 TDs, 9 INTs, 65.6 completion percentage Rushing: Solomon Baggett, 370 yards on 83 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Jaylen Bonelli, 561 yards on 40 catches, 3 TDs Last game Louisiana Tech beat Southern Miss 63-31 on Nov. 14. Baker led Louisiana Tech with 236 yards on 21-of-28 passing (75.0%) for three touchdowns and no interceptions. Rayshun Hurt had 88 rushing yards on six carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for 10 yards. Eli Finley had six receptions for 104 yards and one touchdown. Arkansas State fell to Coastal Carolina 28-21 on Nov. 14. Owens passed for 217 yards on 23-of-40 attempts (57.5%) with no touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 11 times for 34 yards and one rushing touchdown. Baggett carried the ball seven times for 26 yards, adding one reception for 15 yards. Jabari Bush had three receptions for 45 yards. Next game Louisiana Tech plays at Georgia Southern on Nov. 28. Arkansas State hosts Troy on Nov. 28.
